properties.title: United States — country-wide tiled overview
properties.description: Country-wide tiled overview of the United States field-boundary predictions: all 38,659,500 field polygons from the US_* partitions in one multi-scale PMTiles archive. Zooms 0–8 carry an `aggregate` layer of A5 grid cells (resolution 5 at z0–5, resolution 8 at z6–8) with per-cell rollups: `count`, `sum_area`, `avg_area`, `max_area`, `avg_perimeter` (m²/m, from `metrics:*`), per-year counts (`count_2023`, `count_2024`) and per-subdivision counts (`count_<code>`). From z9 a `features` layer carries the individual field polygons (properties: `id`, `area`, `perimeter`, `state`, `year`) through z13. Built with geoparquet-io (A5 aggregation) and tylertoo (tiling); cell rollups are exact sums, not thinned samples.

pmtiles.title: United States — country-wide field tiles (A5 aggregates z0–8, fields z9–13)
